name: Gollum
description_en: Simple, Git-powered wiki with a sweet API and local frontend. `MIT` `Ruby`
description: A simple, Git-powered wiki with a local frontend and support for many kinds of markup and content.
readme_preview:
Gollum is a simple wiki system built on top of Git. A Gollum Wiki is simply a git repository of a specific nature:

*   A Gollum repository's contents are human-editable text or markup files. *   Pages may be organized into directories any way you choose. *   Other content can also be included, for example images, PDFs and headers/footers for your pages. *   Gollum pages: *   May be written in a variety of [markups](#markups). *   Can be edited with your favourite editor (changes will be...
